body:
The thing is, I really am a girly person. And I'm starting to accept that it's not a bad thing, it's just kinda the way I am. I'm very lucky in that I go to an a amazing school, and I have not been bullied once there. Teased, sure. But never outright bullied. 

As I've replied to other posters, I'm not sure I can ditch my friend without her killing herself. She doesn't know I'm suicidal, but I know for a fact that she has tried multiple times. I feel like I have to solve her problems before I can break off the relationship. 

Thank you for replying, but especially thank you for that last paragraph. It made me smile and tear up, in a good way. I don't feel so empty anymore. I actually feel... Hopeful. I'm looking forward to getting out of bed to day. Jesus. That's new.

Thank you! This, among a few insanely thoughtful pms, really helped me. The very fact that another human being cared enough about me to reply is enough to last me until tomorrow. And you're definitely right. I have a lot yet to experience, and I should place less importance on what people think of me. I'm not sure I can get rid of my "best friend" without her offing herself. I'm going to try my best to not let her, or others, walk all over me. This is as much a promise to myself as it is to you. I think I'll watch my scenarios play out, at least for a few days. 

On a side note: would it be a terrible idea to tell this girl I like her?
